name: debate
hook: I gave the debate a live BS meter.
hook_sub: every sentence · both speakers · 5 questions each

questions.label: Factual claim
questions.instructions: Does this sentence make a specific, checkable factual claim (a number, event, record or statistic)?

questions.label: Evasive
questions.instructions: Is this sentence evasive: talking around the issue instead of addressing it directly?

questions.label: Contradicts self
questions.instructions: Does this sentence contradict something this same speaker said earlier (listed under earlier_statements)?

questions.label: Emotional appeal
questions.instructions: Does this sentence rely mainly on emotional appeal (fear, anger, pride, ridicule) rather than evidence or policy?

questions.label: Dodged question
questions.instructions: Given the moderator's question, does this sentence avoid answering what was actually asked?
